programme.title: Untangled Mirror
programme.desc: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur, and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family, and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself as confident and successful. But behind closed doors, she faces child custody battles, tense encounters with her ex, and a controlling new partner.

programme.title: Pearl
programme.desc: Getting out of rehab, losing his girlfriend, and the death of his mother; life has been rough for Travis. Determined to fix his life, Travis gets sober. That is until he meets, Pearl, a girl more dangerous than his addictions.

programme.title: Condemn
programme.desc: College student, Quan, is presented with an opportunity too good to turn down. When she lets her sister, Bree, in on the deal, she takes it to the next level. Soon Quan realizes they both are in too deep, and is faced with the consequences.

programme.title: God's Purpose
programme.desc: A rip-roaring saga of runaway ambition stars Chicago's own Simeon Henderson ("Chicago PD", "Empire") as an arrogant would-be news anchor whose after-word dalliance with the wrong alluring intern sets off a chain of fateful events. Director Kyle Miller brings a grand sense of melodrama to this story of broken faith and the quest for forgiveness.

programme.title: The Next Day
programme.desc: Will and Desire' meet at a bar and have a one night stand, resulting in an unexpected pregnancy. Shortly after, Desire' sees Will's cousin Ike shoot someone and becomes a witness in the investigation. Five years later after Ike has left town, and Will's name has been cleared, Desire reveals a shocking secret.

programme.title: Art of Murder
programme.desc: Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that's connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher. As they close in, Rollins finds himself stuck between protecting his family, and doing what's right.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: Lot Lizards 2: Revenge Route
programme.desc: Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. Into this grim reality storms Ze, who has come to town seeking vengeance on Angie's sister-the woman who murdered his brother, Tez. But Ze's plans are bigger than just revenge: he aims to rally and recruit every woman working the highway.

programme.title: Just Can't Leave You Alone
programme.desc: When a blind date ends in a shootout, Krystal Gray is left with more questions than answers. She discovers a flash drive linked to the murder and a web of secrets involving her brother, a dirty cop, and a mysterious man named Jarrell. As she uncovers the truth, Krystal becomes the target in a deadly game where love and betrayal blur and everyone has a hidden agenda.

programme.title: Exposed
programme.desc: Content creator Mia's serene retreat turns sinister when stalker Damon forces her into a dark livestream. He exposes her deepest secrets, from infidelity to a cover-up in a death, unraveling her life for the world to see. As her husband and best friend are dragged into the chaos, Mia must confront her past or lose everything.

programme.title: Stick Em Game
programme.desc: Struggling to launch her social media career, Elise decides to switch to viral pranks. When one prank on an old acquaintance goes terribly wrong, a local gang leader is out for revenge. With her best friend's help, Elise must fight for her life to survive.

programme.title: When it Rains
programme.desc: While Todd is away at Graduate school to better his family, his wife Janice is back home taking care of her sick mother. The long distance marriage takes a toll on the two. When Todd ends up encountering a woman named Sharon at a bar, sparks fly.

programme.title: Quiet as Kept
programme.desc: Jay is unlawfully detained. His ex-girlfriend returns, and his business partners work to clear his name. Meanwhile, a crooked cop is under suspicion for murder, and connections are made between him and Jay. Torn between duty and loyalty, Detective Johnson is caught in the middle. As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

programme.title: Journey of A Female Comic
programme.desc: The film chronicles the ups and downs of a Hollywood actress/comedian as she struggles to make it in Tinsel Town. It's a comical portrayal of what it takes to achieve success in a town where people confuse Fame with Greatness, with an all-star cast of some of greatest Latino Actors in Hollywood.

programme.title: He'll Never Let Go
programme.desc: Candace's life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with the charismatic Karlton Moore. At first glance, Karlton seems like the epitome of perfection-his looks, charm, and achievements paint an irresistible picture. However, as their relationship deepens, Candace begins to unearth a chilling truth. Karlton harbors a sinister darkness and an overwhelming fear of commitment. What initially appeared as a dreamy romance soon transforms into a harrowing nightmare.

programme.title: Sweet Mahogany 3: The Final Entanglement
programme.desc: The lives of Mahogany Andrews and those around her are drastically changed after devastating news changes relationships and reveals dark secrets from the past that will have a major impact on everyone's future.

programme.title: Tethered Hearts
programme.desc: Token is a charismatic club owner who's inherited his father's iconic jazz club, and uses it at a sanctuary for the broken and struggling artists. When he meets Pearl, a recovering addict, he becomes embroiled in fight to keep his club alive from a shady music executive.

programme.title: Homeboys
programme.desc: Two young men grew up together with childhood goals. They graduated college and tried to begin their professional lives. When one of the homeboys decided to take matters into his own hands. The situation caused the only family he has to have targets on their backs, and it is only a matter of time before things go left.

programme.title: Love and Deceit 2
programme.desc: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women's group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she's there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly's husband.

programme.title: The Good Sister
programme.desc: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin's life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

programme.title: The Special Affect
programme.desc: Expecting mother & artist, Destiny, spirals after a tragic loss. Her loving husband helps her cope, but a bad trip and missed meds spark disturbing memories. With the help of her best friend, Destiny uncovers a horrifying truth about her past.

programme.title: Deadly Housewife
programme.desc: Florence is a housewife who yearns for something new and exciting in her love life. Things turn deadly real quick when she doesn't get what she wants.

programme.title: Chumlee's Dummies
programme.desc: "Pawn Stars" follows three generations of the Harrison family as they assess the value of items coming in and out of their Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas, from the commonplace to the truly historic.

programme.title: Space Kowboy
programme.desc: Rick Dale, one of Pawn Stars' most popular experts, runs Las Vegas based Rick's Restorations, a family business that finds, restores and upcycles cool objects ranging from Cadillacs to Coke Machines. The before and after reveals of his work are always highlights, in part because of the history nuggets Rick Dale shares about each object, whether it's a barber chair or a gas pump. In this spinoff series, featuring the dynamic characters at Rick's workplace, viewers will watch a variety of objects be bought, bartered and transformed, learning the process of restoration -- how do you duplicate Coke machine red? Where can you find 1920's tires? A storyteller who works with tools instead of a pen, Rick shares when and why objects were invented, who used them and how fixing or transforming them changes their value.

programme.title: The Pilum/World War 2 Radios/First Rockets
programme.desc: R. Lee Ermey, who played the sergeant in "Full Metal Jacket", applies his gruff sense of humor in this half-hour series that answers viewers' mail about what the armed forces were, and really are, like! Shot on location, Ermey reads the questions on air and then sends them out to military experts in the field for answers and brief demonstrations.

programme.desc: R. Lee Ermey, who played the sergeant in "Full Metal Jacket", applies his gruff sense of humor in this half-hour series that answers viewers' mail about what the armed forces were, and really are, like! programme.title: Neighbors Know No Boundaries
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

The bad driving phenomenon hasn't helped either-- in fact it's said that 80% of all accidents are caused by 20% of drivers. "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather, insane accidents and a few welcomed instances of acts of kindness.

From fiery exchanges at the fast-food drive thru, to loss-prevention brawls this series proves once and for all that?"The customer is always right"?is the exception rather than the rule.

programme.title: The Grill Sergeant
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.desc: With nearly one-third of Alaska's communities lacking a police force, the state's crime rate is on a meteoric rise. These officers receive special training for the harsh new world and a bonus up to $40,000 ? but if they quit, they must pay it all back.

programme.title: Couples' Cam: Change of Plans
programme.desc: From life's lows like coping with difficult medical diagnoses, to highs like the thrill of moving into a new home or the joys of pregnancy and babies, we watch as the couples experience the many facets of marriage.

programme.title: Kickoff Special
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: In A Family Way
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: Love and Hate (#101)
programme.desc: Unconventional couples on their way to the altar face staunch criticism from loved ones who refuse to give their blessing and set aside personal prejudices about differences_x000D_ in race, religion, class, or sexuality. With wedding plans well in the works, couples, and their futures are on the line. Which couples love will be enough to outweigh the opposition? Which will crack under the pressure? Whose family and friends will show up? And of those that do, will they voice their disapproval or forever hold their_x000D_ peace?

programme.title: Happily Ever Arranged?
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: A is for Arson
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.title: The Burning Secret/Justice Delayed
programme.desc: The series examines each piece of forensic evidence, each witness, each possible lead, and each turn in the road that ultimately leads detectives to their killer. Cold Case Files is a pioneer in the nonfiction forensics genre.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: The Boda Boda Thieves
programme.desc: The Boda Boda Thieves deals with the theme of corruption and the tension between traditional communal values pitted against the prevalent ideology of “dog eat dog” individualism. The film is an African homage and tribute to the great Italian Neo-realist film “The Bicycle Thief” (1948) directed by Vittorio de Sica. We must stress that this is definitely not a remake and that “The Boda Boda Thieves” is an original work that is freely inspired by the great classic. We use the classic as an armature and work to emulate the focus and kinetic simplicity of the original. This is another Yes! That’s Us film and as such we stayed true to our working method of using a small mobile crew of multitasking people. Uganda has received a lot of bad press lately due to a raft of repressive laws against homosexuality, freedom of expression and even miniskirts. Not all Ugandan’s have fallen for these cheap political stunts and many see these outrages for what they are: smokescreens to draw public scrutiny away from the real problem of government kleptocracy. This film examines the issue of crime and corruption, the generation gap and the cult of machismo. As artists we believe in the power of cinema to mirror society for all its imperfect beauty. Slowly but surely positive changes are happening. Despite hardships the people endure they find new ways to make things work. We believe that The Boda Boda Thieves makes commentary on a society in transition.

programme.title: Saint Music
programme.desc: Saint Music is a documentary exploring Ethiopian music, its brief history and the challenges it faces. The film comprises of interviews of the country's music elite including Mr. Yilma Gebre Ab, Mr. Dawit Yifu, Betty G. and others as well as a brief overview of the prominent music school; Yared Music School named after Yared who is considered to be the father of Ethiopian music.

programme.title: Back From Jail
programme.desc: A man released from prison finds his wife about to marry his best friend.

programme.title: Nkinzi
programme.desc: Nkinzi follows an eight-year-old girl who runs away from home and finds refuge in Kampala’s streets, where she meets Junior, a street-smart kid, and his sister Princess. Together, they face urban hardships and form a deep bond on their journey to reunite her with her family. This heartfelt film explores empathy, resilience, and the power of friendship, shedding light on child welfare and the enduring strength of hope and human connection.

programme.title: Wamaitha
programme.desc: This is a love story film set in the colonial era during the height of the Mau Mau rebellion, the story seeks to highlight the role played by women in the Mau Mau arms struggle for independence.

programme.title: Jaja
programme.desc: JAJA is a representation of how people objectify women. sometimes even the women also forget their worth. The problem being within the community which is rigid to change. When a woman speaks up, the community will point fingers at her. Abuse her, calling her all sought of names that will make her appear less of a woman. And yet when a woman decides to keep quiet to avoid criticism, the first assumption is that she is either dumb, stupid or weak. The worst part of it all is when the woman comes from a poor background, she lacks ambition due what people ignore most, fear. She is afraid of believing in herself, she is afraid of achieving more because she may ‘lack a spouse” as the local community dictates, she is afraid that once she succeeds people will not see the effort rather than be blamed for seduction. When in reality most men are not only taking advantage of girls but also working women.The film Jaja brings all these aspects into life. It pushes the motion of women emancipation. We see the protagonist who has been abducted by sex traffickers, her journey throughout the film with the traffickers, and how the authority reacts towards it.We need to free the community from these ideologies that prevent it from progress and make women understand that they dominate their own future, they are phenomenal.

programme.title: Think Smart
programme.desc: Patricia is a beautiful lady who is also not hygienic. Calybus marries Patricia being enchanted by her beauty only to discover how unorganized and untidy she is after marriage. The frustrated young man after pondering how to change Patricia finally comes up with an idea of using the tool of jealousy. He brings another lady into their matrimonial home to make Patricia Jealous with the aim to make her change. But Patricia takes this too personal and decides to retaliate. Only that with Patricia, she cheats for real...What Happens When Patricia Finds Out That His Husband Is Only Playing Games..And His Husband Finds Out That Patricia Is Cheating For Real

programme.title: Ayaanle
programme.desc: AYAANLE is a 21 year old, young man living in Nairobi who aspires to become an actor and reach Hollywood. Despite his conservative upbringing and coming from an impoverished background, he remains optimistic about making it in the film industry and hopes to emulate his hero Denzel Washington. His life is turned upside down after a series of unlikely events that led him to becoming the most wanted man in Kenya and in connection with terror activities across East Africa. The nightmare starts with a corrupt police squad arresting him without due cause. His sister has to use the entire family savings to bail him out of jail leaving the family facing hard times. In his desperation to recoup the funds, Ayaanle is coerced by a friend to join a hoax that he is orchestrating in order to make some quick money. A news crew from the global news network GNN are in Nairobi to film a story about the activities of terror networks in East Africa. The real terror group are unwilling to provide interviews so a friend and Ayaanle conspire to hoodwink the news crew and pretend to be members of the terror group for the purposes of the interview in order to extract some money from the news team. Unfortunately for Ayaanle, the two crooked policemen who arrested him earlier also end up viewing the news item and recognizing him straight away. The cops end up frantically searching for Ayaanle and his team all over Eastleigh Nairob; they want to get to him first before anyone else does. Unfortunately for Ayaanle, this is where his life begins to unravel as he is soon at the mercy of the crooked policemen, an anti-terror unit and other underhanded characters. Left with no options, he is forced to defy all the odds in an attempt to save his life.

programme.title: Hollow
programme.desc: After a devastating miscarriage, Emma and her husband move to a quiet suburban home for a fresh start, but her grief spirals into obsession when she begins hearing a child's voice coming from a locked closet under the stairs. As her sanity and marriage unravel, Emma must confront whether the presence is supernatural or a haunting manifestation of the child she lost.

programme.title: Zero
programme.desc: Alone on her bed, Bénédicte, a thirty-year-old woman, listens religiously to the tube ZERO by Papa Wemba - dead, recently on the FEMUA festival scene in Abidjan. In this candle-lit room, her eyes moisten with tears as her thoughts go into her fourteen years spent in the mythical group of the deceased (VIVA LA MUSICA) before focusing on her fears and on its financial situation. A few days later, Bénédicte, who is known as a dancer, goes to a television station where she talks about her experience alongside the one whom the journalist calls "THE SCHOOLS MASTER " and affectionately calls him "PAPA" (DAD) Before announcing his plan to remix his tube ZERO. For completing her perilous project, whose aim is both to pay tribute to her former boss and launch her career as a singer, Bénédicte was accompanied by Moli - a renowned vocal coach and Tosha - a masterpiece of VIVA LA MUSICA orchestra.

As panic spreads and the city outside carries on unaware, Dalima must confront the force stalking them. Third Floor Pigu is a tense supernatural thriller where love, fear, and survival collide, proving that unimaginable horror can exist

programme.title: The Pretty Ones Are The Loneliest
programme.desc: Emem is a 37-year old woman in a rocky marriage not helped by the fact that her teenage son from a previous relationship, Bassey, always gets in trouble, drawing the angst of his stepfather Tamuno. Emem decides to take him to stay with her Widower Father; Dr. Udoh who had retired and has been living in his country home since the death pf his wife. Bassey who has always searched for a place to belong finds it in his Grandfather's home. They form a bond which transcends that of relatives and he has to help his Grandfather who has a love trouble of his own; He is smitten by a nurse he meets on one of his walks but he has never been with another woman aside his late wife who he had been married to for over 53 years. Emem is still dealing with her crumbling marriage and is tempted when a wild painter she interviews for her magazine falls in love with her. Bassey also somehow gets entangled with an emotionally unavailable girl and all three are trying to overcome their loneliness.

programme.title: Deranged
programme.desc: Widower Dominic questions his daughter Julie about the man responsible for the baby she is carrying but she seems not to remember. Dominic disown Julie with a hard slap and chases her away from home. Unsure, Julie rushes to Allan whom he finds in a hideout playing cards with his gang friends. Allan blasts her straight away, denying to be the father of the baby which confuses Julie furthermore. Unsure again, Julie meets her last resort Wilbur (whom she had sex with a few months back), in a church corridor who also does the same as Allan. But something happens. Wilbur's Wife Emily catches them unaware and when she tries to kill Julie with a knife, Wilbur shields Julie who narrowly escapes. Jealously Emily pierces herself to death. Julie wonders off. Left with no option, she takes poison from an abandoned house where a Psychotic guy Tembo leaves. One hour later, Tembo comes back and finds Julie nearly dying. He rushes her to a nearby clinic, where doctors find out that she had aborted the baby. Later Tembo takes Julie with him to another abandoned warehouse. When Dominic's love for his daughter Julie resurfaces, he starts looking for her but it’s too late. When he later learns that Julie is completely missing, he employs officer Toby and Nita to find her. Tory and Nita brutally arrest Allan together with his new girlfriend and question them about Julies' whereabouts. Allan denies everything, which makes Toby keep both them in custody. Dominic announces on radio and TVs promising to give 800 dollars to whoever find Julie. He also makes a poster that circulate around with Julie's Photo, names, and age. Secretly, Julie hopelessly leaves with Tembo and Nine moths later she delivers a baby at death's door, whom they named "Tine".One day when Tembo goes to steal food for breastfeeding Julie, he is caught and beaten black and blue. He does not come back to Julie anymore, which makes Julie wander off with her baby Tine. She leaves Tine with Eric who once dated her when she was at Tembo's place and goes to her father. Happily, Dominic welcomes and forgives Julie. But shortly, mysteriously Tembo kidnap Julie from the borehole to his new scrappy shelter. He brutally demands Julie for his child Tine but Julie lies to him that Tine died. This is where Emily's Ghost comes in and in revenge, tells Tembo the truth that Julie is lying. Tembo cruelly whips Julie for this.

programme.title: Kapana
programme.desc: George, insurance broker, openly gay in a country where sodomy is still a crime, meets Simeon in a bar. The following day, they accidently meet again at Simeon's work place. Simeon is a Kapana seller (kapana is the local name for barbecued meet). George realises Simeon is in the closet. They keep seeing each other at the market. George then discovers that Simeon also plays soccer and is in the same team as his brother. They start meeting regularly. Simeon even accidentally meets George's family. Everything seems to go well, until Simeon realises George is on ARV. He feels betrayed George has never shared his status before and they break up. While Simeon drinks and tries one night stand with other guys, George gets depressed. Windhoek being a small city, they eventually meet again. In the end Simeon's sister, a nurse, help him understand that he can be with someone who is HIV positive and takes his ARV. Simeon goes back to George, apologising for his behaviour.

programme.title: Liwong
programme.desc: This movie captures a Fondom that refuses to acknowledge a governmental decree, legalising blood and organ donation due to some passed religious belief of the Fon until the Prince gets involved in an auto crash which damages his kidneys and requires transfer. The Fondom is torn apart as some elders want an amendment of the culture while others stick to the old ways for their selfish reasons. The Fon chooses to go the extra mile of saving his son which costs him his life. The struggle of inheritance becomes the next big worry while the prince continues working extremely hard in bringing health to his people while secrets unfold

programme.title: The Rude Awakening
programme.desc: What if Christ paid another visit to earthâ€¦, would he think we were worth dying for? Give the man, power of any kind, and his true character emerges; in the case of President Bonner, his greedy intuition, has no break, and no conscience in amassing wealth by whatever means necessary until he meets a rude awakening in supper natural phenomena in Christ, who appeared to him, to change the narratives, even as his bad side resists, but good always wins.

programme.title: The Herbert Macaulay Affair
programme.desc: The Herbert Macaulay Affair is a story that follows Young Herbert who returns from England and begins the opposition to the colonial government In 1898, Herbert is done with his scholarship training and becomes the first Engineer and Surveyor in the colony. Upon his return he is employed by the Colonial Government in Lagos He faces a lot of discrimination and watches it being done to fellow Lagosians. Annoyed by the constant marginalization, Herbert quits his job with the colonial government and starts a long opposition to them. He meets a beautiful woman Caroline Pratt who he falls madly in love with and unfortunately loses her to death during childbirth. Herbert is devastated and when he emerges from that darkness he delves more into fighting for independence. Our film catalogues a series of historical events which ends with him going to England to represent the Oba at the Privy council despite the colonial government doing everything to stop him. Car chases, Intrigues, schemes, nationalism and family are all part of this intense 90 minutes movie William Benson plays the Title character Herbert Macaulay. A veteran actor of many theatrical performances. He is well-beloved by a lot of Nigerians mostly because of his role as General Ape in the critically-acclaimed primetime drama Ajoche. He has garnered a cult following and delivers an Oscar-worthy performance in our film The Herbert Macaulay Affair

programme.title: First Born
programme.desc: A grade six boy Langcer Divine (Frubi Rollins) is caught in a web of abuse and neglect by his school teachers and peers because of his dullness. He is refused to be registered as an internal candidate for the Common Entrance Examination, as the school wishes to uphold its reputation of academic excellence. Back at home, Divine being the lone child to his parents, goes through emotional torture as they scold at him at every given opportunity. In the midst of his pain and dark clouds, his class teacher Mr. Pangala Nicodemus (Tampy Livinus) comes to his rescue by unraveling a biblical revelation 'Exodus 13:2'. It is discovered that Divine as a first born to his parents, inherited a curse. Could this have been the cause of his dullness or was he a victim of stigmatization and hate by a school system that cares for bright pupils and its reputation to the detriment of slow learners?

programme.title: Dice
programme.desc: Dice tells the story of AJ, a young, nerdy and smart stockbroker who moved to Lagos from London at the age of 10. He has been working at Abubakar Investments for several years and has become very successful at closing sales deals and making 'little' commission from them. AJ is perceived to have a dual personality; one he exhibits at work as a young naÃ¯ve and nerdy individual and the other outside work as an extrovert. At work, his colleagues Emeka and Bala often throw shade at him and bully him because they find him extremely boring and simple. They also find him slow because of his inability to stand up for himself and demand his rightful 3% Commission. Unknown to them AJ has a good life outside of work as he often hangs out at the club with his best friend Segun, both are serial ladies and men. Emeka & Bala are aware that Mr. Abubakar constantly cheats him off his commission, but are unaware that he has taken matters into his own hands by using clients' funds to engage in side hustles beneficial to him. This side hustling however gets him in trouble when he loses a client's money and has to borrow money from a gangster which he fails to pay back on time. His external deals also lead to the company being investigated by EFFD as several holes have been spotted in the company's financials. Having had bad luck with ladies in the past, AJ finally finds love in the weirdest place when he meets Amaka and finds himself having to fight for the woman of his dreams who he also puts in danger.

programme.title: Peremende
programme.desc: To save her dying son, Latifa sells an organ and enters a deadly trafficking ring run by a compromised surgeon and a crime boss. Trapped in a system that exploits the poor, a single mistake forces her to decide between silence or destroying the machine that profits from her poverty.

programme.title: Made In Heaven
programme.desc: Richard is a nerdy and awkward romantic, consistently unlucky in love. He finds himself in a bad situation which leads to a tragic end, but then he is given a second chance at life to find love, with a very limited time.

programme.title: A Beautiful Day To Die (Une Bonne Journee Pour Mourir)
programme.desc: After celebrating Sasha's birthday with bottles of beers and whiskies, her three friends, Johnn, Tom, and Sam decide to take her to a nearby town for more celebrations but on their way, their car hits and kills a passerby on a lonesome road. They decide to hide the crime as Johnny, the governor's son argues that it will negatively influence his father's political career. However, on their way to bury the corpse, their car is stopped by a police officer and as the officer discovers the corpse, he is shot dead by Johnny but unfortunately during the clash, the officers shoots at Sam. To cover up this new crime three other people will die.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Neema, a successful accountant haunted by her past, seeks her missing sister Tabu with relentless determination, guided by a witch doctor. Her journey is fraught with trials—getting lost in a mystical forest, surviving a bus fire, and encountering Sabri, a teacher, and Farida, a bar owner who alternates between ally and adversary. In a remote village, Neema faces moral dilemmas and violent confrontations, uncovering shocking truths about Tabu’s abusive husband Frank. Their reunion is bittersweet as Tabu refuses to leave Frank. After he brutally attacks Tabu, Neema exacts revenge in a deadly showdown, leaving her broken and bleeding on a bridge. Themes of family loyalty, sacrifice, and violence paint a vivid picture of resilience and despair.

programme.title: Breaking with Customs
programme.desc: Tyranny chief with his guards storms Nono’s home for her daughter Nsanji whom the chief wants to be his fourth wife as tradition puts it. But Nsanji refuses because she loves Mpaka, her long-time fiancé. When the Chief leaves, Nono beats Nsanji badly until she accepts to marry the Chief. When the inflexible Mpaka gets to know about it, he launches war against the chief although his Father warns him not to defy tradition. Shortly, Mpaka helps Nsanji escape from the palace. Quickly, the Chief launches a deadly hunt for them, and soldiers search the whole village until they capture them one by one. While on a punishment podium, whipped Mpaka swears never to dump Nsanji and Nsanji does the same.

And the spoils of the war were only going to be shared with a few...

programme.title: Anna Ferrah's Story
programme.desc: Anna, married to Tobi, struggles with infertility. After Tobiâ€™s mother moves in, tensions rise, culminating in a fight where Anna learns sheâ€™s blamed for the coupleâ€™s childlessness. The mother storms out, is â€œkidnapped,â€ and demands ransom, warning against police involvement. Anna alerts Inspector Mike anyway. Tobi pays the ransom, but Mike traces the money, uncovering a shocking truth: Tobiâ€™s mother faked her kidnapping to frame Anna and push Tobi into remarrying her best friend. Exposed, sheâ€™s arrested and confesses. But Tobi still blames Anna and leaves her.

programme.title: Once Upon a Family
programme.desc: Every family has its issues, and this one is no exception. Once Upon A Family tells the story of a complicated Ghanaian family and the dark secrets they wished to hide - but all comes to light during the family reunion of a lifetime.

programme.title: Kienyeji
programme.desc: Kienyeji tells the story of two university students, Cynthia and Charlie, from conflicting Kenyan communities who fall in love and plan to marry despite their families' opposition. The narrative explores tribalism and cultural differences as their attempts to unite face challenges, including a failed ruracio due to unpaid dowry, food poisoning at a second attempt, and ultimately, divorce pressured by Charlie's father. Amid exams, financial struggles, and personal setbacks, their journey unfolds with Ohangla and Mugithi music, raising questions about love and tradition. Will love triumph, or will societal pressures prevail?

programme.title: Mono
programme.desc: "Young students arrive at the prestigious Francis Morris Morton Mission High School (Framomo) to join Form One. Their parents believe that this is the right school to turn their sons into men. As the boys discover a deep and sinister rot in the school, they try to fight for their voice, but it could cost them more than they are willing to sacrifice. Will Oliver and his friends survive Framomo?"

programme.title: Prato Frio
programme.desc: Erica, a 19-year-old young woman, lives a seemingly perfect life with her wealthy parents. But her world shatters when armed intruders break into their home and brutally murder her family. As she grieves, the truth comes to light â€” "Frozen Revenge" unfolds as a gripping psychological thriller exploring trauma, betrayal, and vengeance, set against the backdrop of modern-day Mozambique. A powerful story of a young woman who turns pain into a relentless pursuit of revenge.

programme.title: Villains in the Metropolis
programme.desc: A brilliant young medical doctor, stunningly beautiful, morphs into a heartless murderer after a positive pregnancy test, and a cheating lover.

programme.title: The Department
programme.desc: She used to live in Lagos, Nigeria and run industrial sabotage for a Nigerian conglomerate until she got married and moved to the suburbs. Now she's a bored housewife and her company wants her back for one last job. She accepts against the wishes of her husband who then decides to sabotage the project in an attempt to save their marriage.

programme.title: Strawberry Chinny
programme.desc: After a brutal breakup leaves her homeless, a 28-year-old makeup artist moves in with her childhood best friend, but their platonic bond is tested when his demanding new girlfriend enters the picture, forcing them to confront their true feelings for each other.

programme.title: The Confessor
programme.desc: Rev. Johnson a thirty-five year old priest loses his sister and only remaining family member at the hands of some armed robbers. His efforts to get the police to bring the culprits to book prove abortive, as they made no serious efforts to hunt down the criminals. Disappointed in the way the Nigerian police handled the case, he went away for a while to try to heal and returns a year later to continue his role as a priest. 3 years later, he listens to the confession of an armed robber who narrates a brutal rape and murder of a girl, five years earlier. This brought back old memories and a battle with his conscience, faith and deep seated hate still lies in his heart. After listening to the confession of the armed robber, it becomes clear that he was one of the robber's responsible for his sister's death. He decides to take the law into his own hands by finding all the men responsible for his sister's death and make them pay for their actions. This new development sends chills down the spine of members of the community, as the police and the people begin to wonder if they now have a vigilant or just a murderer.

programme.title: Soul Boy
programme.desc: Nairobi, Kenya. 14 year-old Abila lives with his parents in Kibera, one of the largest slums in East Africa. One morning the teenager discovers his father ill and delirious. Someone has stolen his soul, mumbles the father as he sits huddled in a corner. Abila is shocked and confused but wants to help his father and goes in search of a suitable cure. Supported by his friend Shiku who is the same age as him, he learns that his father has gambled his soul away in the company of a spiritual woman. The teenager doesn’t want to believe it and sets about looking for the witch. When he finally discovers her in the darkest corner of the ghetto, she gives him seven challenging tasks to save his father’s lost soul. Abila embarks on an adventurous journey which leads him right through the microcosm of his home town.

programme.title: Wheel and Deal
programme.desc: Addicted to the desire for this pleasurable life leads a retired Marine Corps to plot a scheme along with a computer genius on how to get rich regardless of those involved. A one million dollars life insurance policy is his initiative and his children;Georgia, Kelvin and Regina are his beneficiaries including his grandchildren (Ben Jr & Benita). To receive the money once he’s dead, he carries on his first plan. He and his felon partner who happens to be a genius in hijacking, infiltrate the health system, pose as the personal to Kels by creating a terminal disease that Kels (this Ex-Marie Corps) suffers from.

programme.title: Gacal
programme.desc: Lonely and heartbroken, Assad is left at home while his charming brother, Nuur, heads out on a long-awaited date with a woman he has been pursuing. Little does Assad know that this day will turn his life upside down. Just as Nuur steps out, a sudden knock on the door startles Assad. Opening it, he is met with a powerful punch to the face. Standing before him is Barkhad, the husband of the woman Nuur is currently on a date with. Barkhad, in a case of mistaken identity, believes Assad is his wife's illicit lover.Fueled by anger and a desire to seek revenge on Nuur, Barkhad decides to take matters into his own hands. He restrains Assad as he waits, knife in hand, for Nuur to return. As the day unfolds, a twist of fate intertwines the lives of Assad, Barkhad, and Nuur. Forced to spend time together, Assad and Barkhad gradually find common ground and an unexpected bond. Sharing their stories and vulnerabilities, they start to question their judgments and perceptions of one another.

programme.title: Daughters of Donald
programme.desc: Chief Donald is living the later years of his life in lonesome luxury and perfect celibacy. But the peace and quiet in his big mansion are shattered when one young lady, and then another, suddenly show up claiming to be his daughters from past relationships he had completely forgotten about. And it will not stop there: everyone is now a suspect as ghosts from Chief Donald’s adventurous past come to haunt him in the form of children, he never knew he had, including some who have been living and working right under his nose, unbeknownst to him. The cultural conflicts and heartbreaking drama resulting from this late discovery of self, and the trauma imposed by DNA tests and struggles for belonging, are only subdued by the hilarious natures of the comic characters who bring the whole story to life. The movie is set in Asaba (Nollywood), Nigeria, featuring actors from Cameroon and Nigeria. Generous use of African Music provided by BGC Melody from Cameroon, Congo DRC, Ghana and Nigeria. Executive Production by Don Julio Bats for BGC Melody Story

programme.title: In My Father's Village
programme.desc: Rhuveneko, 19, rides on a bus and opens a picture book, gazing at old pictures of her father. She goes back to his village to claim her inheritance, but things have changed. Zimbabwe became independent in 1980. A fierce liberation war had brought the long-awaited freedom, but the scars of this war are still felt until today. And the spoils of the war were only going to be shared with a few...

programme.title: Moms at War
programme.desc: Moms at War is about two mothers who live in the same neighborhood, but hate each other. One felt that the other was a village girl who just got into money and is not fit to be in society with them. But both their kids coincidentally attend the same school and there was a competition that was done for the kids, and both were the top of their class. It comes down to one of them winning the competition and the mothers just go crazy, doing all sort of antics. It's a story of friendship, sisterhood, and bonding in spite of everything.

programme.title: Minga et la Cuissinière
programme.desc: Minga is an orphaned girl living with her stepmother Mami Kaba and her stepsister Abena. One day, when she was washing dishes in the river, she accidentally broke a spoon. A furious Mami Kaba then chased her away from the house, asking her to find the only identical spoon hidden by her late mother. A adventurous journey then begins for Minga in the forest.

programme.title: Kileo
programme.desc: Tabu (30s) is a high-performing secondary school English teacher, struggling with alcoholism. Intelligent but reckless, Tabu is cheerful most especially when under the influence, and is a low-spirited nerd when level headed.

programme.title: Watatu
programme.desc: Yusuf is a young university graduate suffering discrimination, lack of opportunity and is raging against injustice. He slowly becomes seduced by extremist thought, which leaves his family powerless to dissuade him. His Uncle Salim, the only father figure in his life, is helpless in the face of his nephew’s ideology. When Salim discovers his new next-door neighbour is actually his long lost childhood friend, Jack, he is delighted. But Jack has become a policeman, a job which in a City increasingly divided by religion and tribe and simmering with violence, places a seemingly unbridgeable gulf between them. Yusuf, Jack and Salim’s lives become fatally and irrevocably entwined as Salim struggles to hold his friendship, family and community together. But Yusuf’s sister has another plan. Knowing that the communities of Mombasa may have the solution, she takes her story to the streets. As the film morphs into a documentary, we see real people in Mombasa assume the roles of Yusuf’s mother, sister and uncle, taking the story into their own hands to determine a new ending and in doing so give voice to the majority Muslim community of coastal Kenya drowned out by extremists on the one side and Government repression on the other. Can the citizens of Mombasa change the tragic outcome of this story?

programme.title: Zahma
programme.desc: Zahma (2023) It tells a story of a widow, Munira raises her despondent teenage son Zuber alone after her husband Changawa disappears mysteriously. When she discovers that a village boy is behind her son's misery, she seeks the help of a former witchcraft practitioner named Zobe. However, chaos ensues when dark secrets reveal Zobe's involvement in Changawa's disappearance.

programme.title: Rishai
programme.desc: Nyakio finds herself consumed by depression and overwhelming guilt following the tragic drowning of her son. Her despair reaches a breaking point, leading her to contemplate taking her own life. With a noose around her neck as she is about to surrender to the darkness, Jay, a tough debt collector working for a local loan shark, storms into her home. Nyakio owes money and he’s come to collect. Fate brings these two disparate souls together, forcing them to share an unexpected weekend. As they reluctantly share this time, Nyakio gradually realizes that Jay carries his own profound emotional wounds, which bear a surprising resemblance to her own. Through their shared experiences and unforeseen misadventures, Nyakio and Jay unwittingly heal each other along the way and get within the grasp of finding hope and a will to live.

programme.title: The Pretty Ones Are The Loneliest
programme.desc: Emem is a 37-year old woman in a rocky marriage not helped by the fact that her teenage son from a previous relationship, Bassey, always gets in trouble, drawing the angst of his stepfather Tamuno. Emem decides to take him to stay with her Widower Father; Dr. Udoh who had retired and has been living in his country home since the death pf his wife. Bassey who has always searched for a place to belong finds it in his Grandfather's home. They form a bond which transcends that of relatives and he has to help his Grandfather who has a love trouble of his own; He is smitten by a nurse he meets on one of his walks but he has never been with another woman aside his late wife who he had been married to for over 53 years. Emem is still dealing with her crumbling marriage and is tempted when a wild painter she interviews for her magazine falls in love with her. Bassey also somehow gets entangled with an emotionally unavailable girl and all three are trying to overcome their loneliness.

programme.title: Coerced Revenge
programme.desc: A story about a young girl forced to bomb a university by her uncle to save her mother's life.

programme.title: Okomfo Anokye Poma (The Missing Staff)
programme.desc: A man dies and willed all his properties to his son but he can't inherit them unless he goes back to his father's hometown to fight and bring back the Staff of Okomfo Anokye. Okomfo Anokye is a legendary African priest who lived in Ancient times. What is the connection between the Man and OKOMFO ANOKYE and what is the connection between The Past and The Present?

programme.title: Wrong Journey
programme.desc: Some university students go for a trip to a waterfall in a sacred forest for sightseeing and Michael one of them dies. forced to run, they abandon his Corps. as they get to their homes, something is hunting and eliminating them one after the other. until then, Aaron waits and Michael his brother never returned and he has no idea what happened to his twin brother. He decides to go look for him the following day, getting to the waterfall, there lies his brother. Furious and in agony, he screams over his Corps and leaves it the way he met it. immediately as he leaves, a black faceless hooded figure rises from the shrine sterring at him.

programme.desc: An African dance troupe lives out their struggles as artists and individuals, focusing on the love story of Pearl and David pursuing their dreams despite obstacles.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S04 E06
programme.desc: A Tennessee native, John Coffee Hays heads to the frontier of Texas in the 1830s and signs on as an early member of the Texas Rangers. In 1844, Hays becomes a legend when he leads a small band of rangers in a desperate fight with the Comanche.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E02
programme.desc: The cowboys head to Texas! A simple wrangling job leads to the perfect cattle trading opportunity. The guys plot a course for Texas to capitalize on a buyer's market. Cody forgets his saddle on a routine roundup, and the only thing sorer than his backside is his ego when Booger and Bubba don't let him live down his mistake. After months of searching, Jaclyn and Booger finally find a piece of land perfect for settling down. But can they pull the trigger on the property before someone else swoops in? Bubba gets in hot water with Kaley when he tells Andrew, a long-term friend and ranch hand, that he can crash at their place - but without asking her first. Still licking his wounds from a double-cross, Cody weighs the pros and cons of holding his own rodeo. As their wives juggle life back home, the cowboys hit the road to broker their first big deal. They hope to find the crossbred cattle their buyer is looking for in the Lone Star State.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E08
programme.desc: Dandy Jim Buckley convinces Bret Maverick to partner with him on a deal to buy cavalry horses. However, Bret learns it's just another trick. To get his money back, Bret must break Buckley out of an escape-proof jail.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E05
programme.desc: When a mining accident kills wealthy cattle rancher Sam Magruder and injures Cheyenne, another man assumes Magruder's identity. Cheyenne is suspicious and takes on a job on his ranch to investigate.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S04 E06
programme.desc: Cheyenne meets a tough as nails rancher who hires him as a foreman. He soon faces hostility from fellow ranch employees and the rancher, who has a firm grip on his land, the town, and his handicapped daughter.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E18
programme.desc: A dying friend of Lucas McCain's asks him to go to a nearby town to bring back his wife, Elizabeth, so he can see her one last time. Lucas agrees but is surprised to find a beautiful, young actress who is not interested in grieving over her husband.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S03 E19
programme.desc: Lucas thinks he has seen a ghost when he comes face-to-face with Simon Lee, a young man who looks exactly like a Confederate officer he killed during the Civil War. Simon Lee is fast with a gun, and provokes Lucas into a life and death situation.

programme.title: Maverick - S04 E13
programme.desc: On his way to the bank, Bart Maverick stops to help a distressed woman who hires him to take her to Dodge City. Later, Bart finds stolen cash in his saddle bags and is wanted for robbery and the murder of the bank president.

programme.title: Doc West's Challenge
programme.desc: A skilled card player, sharp-shooter, and doctor plans to settle down in a quaint town. He makes trouble for himself when he invites a wild and unseemly bunch of characters to town for a poker tournament, hoping to raise money for a noble cause.

programme.title: Noticiero N+ Univisión - Edición Digital East
programme.desc: Noticias de hechos mundiales relevantes para la comunidad hispana.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Hazlo con ella
programme.desc: Gracias a una película, Albertano descubre una manera poco inusual de sacar a María del coma. Albertano con la ayuda de Betzabé trata de poner en marcha su plan, pero es interrumpido por Doña Lucha y Carmelo.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Día de campo
programme.desc: Federica y Ludovico se pelean por ver la televisión y la descomponen y Bibi les dice que pueden leer para entretenerse. Ludovico propone llevar a la familia a un picnic para distraerse.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Quinceañera
programme.desc: Ludovico le pide a Don Camerino que sea el padrino de Bibi para que pague su fiesta de XV años. Don Camerino da el dinero para la fiesta pero Ludovico y Federica se lo gastan en otras cosas por lo que improvisan la fiesta.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Se nos casa Antoña
programme.desc: Toña se encuentra indecisa, pues no sabe si casarse con Brayan Danielle o con Pascual. Tras aclarar su mente, celebra en grande su despedida de soltera.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - La boda de Toña
programme.desc: Después de los excesos en sus despedidas de solteros, llega el día de la boda entre Toña y Brayan Danielle. ¿Le dará el sí o lo dejará como novio de pueblo?

programme.title: Vecinos - Mis pobres diablillos
programme.desc: Benito y sus amigos hacen travesuras a los vecinos con ayuda de Pedro. Los vecinos hacen una junta pues tienen que hacer algo para que los niños dejen de hacer travesuras.

programme.title: Vecinos - Competencia de hot dogs
programme.desc: Una mujer casi atropella a Luis, por lo que los vecinos quieren que construyan un tope. Para obtener dinero, Lorena pone un puesto de hot dogs y Magda le hace la competencia.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 2
programme.desc: Albertano y Vítor organizan una fiesta para celebrar que son millonarios y cierran la calle de su colonia, una policía trata de impedirlo, pero al darse cuenta que Lupillo Rivera cantará decide quedarse.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 3
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano organizan una fiesta con hermosas mujeres para disfrutar de su vida de millonarios, pero las cosas no salen como esperaban.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - No andaban muertos
programme.desc: Márgara trata de reunir a los Héroes y Zacarías regresa a la banda. Hassan secuestra a Prisca. Los Héroes se presentan ante los medios y hay reacciones encontradas.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 4
programme.desc: Albertano y Vítor despiertan en una playa, perdidos y sin saber qué pasó, deciden buscar juntos a Natacha para regresar a su casa.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 5
programme.desc: Dos hermosas mujeres deciden vivir con Cuca y Nacho, ellos las aceptan felices sin saber que son peligrosas estafadoras, pero Albertano y Vítor los salvan.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Niño envuelto
programme.desc: Es el santo de Plácido y quiere festejarlo con una cena. Además, Tulio se fue de la casa, y ahora, ¿Gertrudis en donde vivirá?

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Acuerdate de Acapulco
programme.desc: Plácido se quedó sin pensión y deberá conseguir dinero para mantener a su familia. Además, un exnovio de la nena quiere recuperarla.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Madre solo hay una
programme.desc: A Martina se le ocurre una idea para molestar a su prima la nena. Además, Justito pasa por el rechazo de sus amigos por ser el más inteligente.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - Éramos muchos
programme.desc: El exnovio Carlos regresa a casa de los López para pedir asilo. Además, Placido y Aldolfo tendrán que trabajar para pagar la deuda en Acapulco.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Coma pozole
programme.desc: María ha despertado del coma y para recibirla en la vecindad, Doña Lucha se ve forzada a hacer una comida de bienvenida. Durante la reunión, Glenda aparece para obligar a Albertano a quedarse con ella.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Tiempo de amigos
programme.desc: María trata de recuperar su vida después de haber estado en coma y decide formalizar su relación con Albertano, pero él solo quiere que sea su amiga. Doña Lucha se preocupa porque cree que el Macaco es mala influencia para el Chino.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Niños de oro
programme.desc: Ludovico y Federica inscriben a Junior en el concurso 'Niños de Oro', dónde participa cantando opera. El objetivo de Federiva y Ludovico es ganar el gran premio y recuperar lo que han gastado en Junior.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Sueño de telenovela
programme.desc: Federica manda a Ludovico a dormir a la sala porque se pone muy sentimental al ver la telenovela. Ludovico sueña que está en una telenovela y se casa con María Josefina, la sirvienta de su casa.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Clavado en La Quebrada
programme.desc: Toña se va de fiesta a Acapulco para olvidar a Brayan. Él quiere recuperarla y la sigue, pero debe cumplir una condición para ser perdonado: saltar de La Quebrada.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Y volver volver
programme.desc: Brayan agarra valor y se avienta de La Quebrada. Todo se complica a su regreso a la ciudad con la llegada de Irmita. ¿Miranda y Paco se darán otra oportunidad?

programme.title: Vecinos - Viaje a Canadá parte 1
programme.desc: Magda se niega a pagarle a Germán para arreglar la pared del edificio. Benito consigue un comercial en Canadá y mientras él trabaja, Frankie y Lorena van a esquiar. Eugenio Derbez y Alessandra Rosaldo llegan de incógnito al mismo hotel.

programme.title: Vecinos - Viaje a Canadá parte 2
programme.desc: Frankie consigue por error un maletín con secretos íntimos de Eugenio Derbez y Alessandra Rosaldo y decide chantajear a Derbez y obligarlo para que le compre sus guiones.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - No andaban muertos

programme.desc: Reina Altagracia, la mamá de María, regresa para reencontrarse con su hija, pero ella no la acepta. Doña Lucha decide organizar una tarde de juegos con sus hijos, pero todo se complica cuando Reina comienza a apostar las cosas de María.
